description: Overwrites a wallet's saved token watchlist (up to 200 tokens). Requires a signature proving ownership of the address: sign the exact string in 'message' with that wallet's key (e.g. personal_sign / EIP-191) and pass it as 'signature'. Not usable without real wallet-signing capability.

message.description: the exact message that was signed

tokens.description: token addresses to save, up to 200

name: save_watchlist
title: Save a wallet's watchlist
